plugins.name: zcode-worklog
plugins.description: Local work journal for ZCode: archive daily Git commits and document changes, edit daily logs, manage todos, generate daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reports, search the archive, and open a WorkLog side panel. Data stays on this machine.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 本机工作日志：归档 Git 提交与文档变更、待办、日报/周报/月报/季报、侧边面板。
